title: BuyBoxMatchRequest
description: Schema for evaluating commercial loan applicant attributes against lender buy-box matrices.

annual_revenue.description: Gross annual business revenue in USD.

avg_monthly_deposits.description: Average monthly bank deposits in USD.

collateral_available.description: Whether borrower has pledgeable machinery, real estate, AR, or inventory.

has_tax_liens.description: Whether open federal/state tax liens exist.

has_bankruptcy.description: Whether bankruptcy has been filed in last 3 years.
